$comment: Live question generation. Every domain first gets 'initial_per_domain' questions (each retried up to 'initial_max_attempts' times until one passes the checks). After that 'policy' decides per domain: threshold = by the domain's standard error (SE); 'external' asks another system.

threshold.$comment: SE above more.se_above → keep more ready; between target_se and that → normal; SE at or below the domain's target_se → stop generating for it.

written.$comment: Written questions use the free-form prompt (src/generation/freeform.ts). order generate_first: a new question is written for every written slot (per_call per Gemini call, each answer key checked by a second call); a stored question the user has not seen is used only if writing fails (provider paused, quota used up, or every new question rejected). Memory keeps its study-then-recall word task; add "memory" to domains to change that.
